description: H11 classifies every effective Partial Microsoft source contract for the R08 exit gate. Classification is deliberately conservative: Partial is functional debt unless an explicit evidence-backed exception proves the remaining difference is platform-boundary, language/API-shape, or upstream-ignored.

exceptions.reason: The remaining Microsoft branches are MapVirtualKeyW/default-character translation and native non-KEY INPUT_RECORD dispatch, while the deterministic VT key semantics are already witnessed in Rust.
The remaining NUL virtual-key lookup is produced by VkKeyScanExW under an explicitly selected Windows keyboard layout.
The remaining key-identity observations are derived through Windows keyboard-layout translation; deterministic emitted VT semantics already have direct Rust evidence.
The Rust core already preserves the dead-key no-output semantic; only the Windows ToUnicodeEx KeyboardMapper adapter remains outside the portable owner.
The remaining differences are C++ vector ownership/lifetime helper mechanics replaced by Rust Vec ownership rather than product behavior.
Rust Option supplies the portable first/default-value semantic; the exact C++ helper API is intentionally not a migrated product contract.
Set membership is represented by Rust collection/value semantics; the C++ enum_set helper shape is not product behavior.
Sorted unique-set behavior is carried by Rust BTreeSet; TIL storage/performance representation is not a migrated semantic contract.
The migrated owner needs Rust Hash/Hasher semantics, not TIL's implementation-specific 32/64-bit hash algorithm vectors.
Portable exclusion/ownership semantics are represented by Rust Mutex; the remaining implementation details are Windows synchronization mechanics.
Insertion/copy/vector observables use Rust Vec; small-buffer optimization and C++ self-move mechanics are implementation-shape differences.
The portable producer/consumer ordering baseline is represented by Rust synchronization; TIL revolution/drop internals are implementation mechanics rather than product semantics.
Lookup/key ordering semantics use Rust BTreeMap; compile-time static-map representation and presort implementation are C++ API-shape details.
Rust decode_utf16 owns surrogate pairing/replacement; TIL's borrowed-slice utf16_next iterator API is intentionally not reproduced.
Microsoft marks this source method Ignore=true because its current C++ matcher does not implement the ß-to-ss multi-code-point full-fold expectation.
